_comment: Test-framework scroll offset (9 Nov 2026): after the tap that scrolls to a node, the sheet's scrolled content sits 4 px lower (small) or 1 px higher (ar) than in the golden because Compose 1.12's scroll-to-node aligns differently from 1.7; the region must match EXACTLY after shifting, so any real layout change still fails. Replace by a deterministic scroll when the harness is re-baselined (P4).
